title: Exploring Social Desirability Response Bias in Large Language Models: Evidence from GPT-4 Simulations

bias_targets.methodology: Assigning GPT-4 personas based on Gallup World Poll data and prompting them with or without a survey commitment statement, then measuring the effect on generated responses using a 13-item SDR index and a Civic Engagement (CE) index.

Comparing the predictive performance (F1 scores) of the model's simulated civic engagement responses across four distinct societies (USA, UK, Hong Kong, South Africa) against actual survey data to detect homogenized responses and Western-centric biases.
